summary: Verified 'Créer un compte' relabel + parent-mode toggle (new/join) in register.tsx. Second-parent join E2E works end-to-end: parent 2 joins existing family_id, verifies own PIN (2222), creates a task (parent-only) with the pin_token, and GET /api/family lists both parents. Negative paths return 404 (bad family_id) and 400 (parent without pin). Regressions pass: child registration requires valid family_id (200 valid / 404 invalid), demo logins (papa@demo.fr, lea@demo.fr) succeed, PIN 1234 verifies for demo parent. Frontend UI: Join mode hides family-name input, shows family-id input + helper text + PIN input; New mode shows family-name + PIN. UI E2E: registered second parent via UI, landed on parent dashboard 'Bonjour Maman UI' with correct family + family code displayed. 7/7 backend tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1050 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, tasks, rewards, calendar, challenges) in a future iteration for maintainability, but not blocking.
register.tsx correctly guards join mode with empty family_id check; new-family mode falls back to `Famille de <name>` when family name blank — acceptable UX.
seed_data_creation: Auto-seed on backend startup creates papa@demo.fr / lea@demo.fr / hugo@demo.fr / emma@demo.fr (Famille Dupont). Test data uses TEST_ prefix and throwaway UUID emails; not cleaned up but isolated from demo seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Second-parent join flow is fully wired frontend+backend. testIDs on register: parent-mode-new, parent-mode-join, register-familyname-input, register-parent-familyid-input, register-pin-input. Login link testID go-register-button now reads 'Créer un compte'. Auth flow: register -> access_token; parent must POST /api/auth/pin/verify to get pin_token then pass in X-Parent-Pin-Token header for parent-only endpoints (POST /api/tasks, /api/rewards, /api/challenges, DELETE variants).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. All requested change-request behaviors verified independently.
